limits: Name/tag/N signatures describe capped displayed aggregation identities, not raw tool schema/body hashes
calibrate scales all parts and items equally then rounds; largest part absorbs total rounding residual
Ratio intervals assume system not largest and tools error <=0.5 unless tools largest, when <=(part_count-1)/2
Absent skills/memory is absence of classification, not proof their text is absent from system
Native user counts use role=user records only; prompt.turns is parser heuristic, not wire input count
Constant estimated token ratios do not prove byte-for-byte stability or absence of equal-length mutations
